title: Denmark’s Christopher set for biggest ever homegrown headline show
summary: Promoter DTD Concerts has said Danish language pop is enjoying a”growing commercial appeal”, following an on-sale for a 2027 show by Danish singer Christopher which is set to make it the biggest headline concert in Danish history by a homegrown artist. DTD told IQ the concert sold 60,000 tickets in 54 hours and required a last-minute effort to add 10,000 further spaces once the initial 50,000 capacity was exhausted.
